Interface ClientActivityDetector

All Known Implementing Classes:
InMemoryClientActivityDetector
public interface ClientActivityDetector
Notices when more than one client (a tab, a window, a device) is working on the same thing at once (issue #273).

Every request that touches the thing says who sent it, by a random identifier the client made for itself. The detector remembers which identifiers it saw on each resource key (any string, such as "draft:42") within the window, and answers whether anyone other than the caller was among them. It is advice, not a lock.

This package depends on nothing else in the application, so that it could be lifted out as a library of its own. The implementation here keeps its state in memory; see InMemoryClientActivityDetector for what that means for more than one server.
